calibration: per-domain per-poll, budget 0.01, own validation benign

hypotheses.H1: fedavg harms fewer benign flows than lib-dms (main design, online)
hypotheses.H2: fedavg harms fewer benign flows than ensemble (main design, online)
hypotheses.H3: fedavg harms fewer benign flows than lib-all (main design, online)
hypotheses.H4: fedavg is within 1 percentage point of pooled on benign flows harmed (main design)
hypotheses.H5: on held-out variants (LOVO, online) fedavg harms fewer benign flows than local and lib-dms
hypotheses.H6: the fedavg - local gap in offline held-out TPR shrinks as exposure skew decreases (alpha up)

decision: If lib-dms is not worse than fedavg on benign flows harmed (cluster Wilcoxon, Holm p >= 0.05, or mean difference < 0.5 points), federation is not necessary given a public attack library: re-scope the paper to the mitigation policy with federation as an optional deployment. lib-all is reported as an upper bound for libraries but is not part of the decision, because it assumes generators for every attack variant are public.
